"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build report.pptx (4-slide engineering test briefing) from perf_02.csv."""

import csv

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

CSV_PATH = "perf_02.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.pptx"
COLUMNS = ["config", "cl_max", "cd_cruise", "ld_ratio"]


def norm_header(h):
    return h.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")


def load_records(path):
    """Read the CSV and return records with raw strings plus float values."""
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        reader = csv.reader(fh)
        rows = [r for r in reader if any(c.strip() for c in r)]
    if len(rows) < 2:
        raise ValueError("perf_02.csv must contain a header plus at least one data row")
    header = [norm_header(h) for h in rows[0]]
    idx = {name: header.index(name) for name in COLUMNS}
    records = []
    for r in rows[1:]:
        rec = {c: r[idx[c]].strip() for c in COLUMNS}
        rec["_cl"] = float(rec["cl_max"])
        rec["_cd"] = float(rec["cd_cruise"])
        rec["_ld"] = float(rec["ld_ratio"])
        records.append(rec)
    return records


def set_cell_text(cell, text, bold=False, size=12, header=False):
    cell.text = text
    if header:
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0xD9, 0xE2, 0xF3)
    for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in p.runs:
            run.font.size = Pt(size)
            run.font.bold = bold


def main():
    records = load_records(CSV_PATH)

    # --- compute all statistics from the CSV data ---
    cl_vals = [r["_cl"] for r in records]
    cd_vals = [r["_cd"] for r in records]
    ld_vals = [r["_ld"] for r in records]

    cl_max = max(cl_vals)
    cd_mean = sum(cd_vals) / len(cd_vals)
    ld_mean = sum(ld_vals) / len(ld_vals)
    best_cfg = max(records, key=lambda r: r["_ld"])["config"]

    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

    # ---- Slide 1: Title ----
    s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
    s1.shapes.title.text = "Engineering Test Briefing"
    s1.placeholders[1].text = "Aerodynamic performance data review"
